pr.title: DCP readonly MCP facade architecture and task series
pr.body:
Create repo-tracked architecture, registry, tool-contract, response-envelope, security-model, build-series, and decision docs for the multi-project read-only evidence facade.

Required PR sections: Objective, Scope, Evidence, Validation, Embedded audit, Risks and unknowns, Rollback, Proof bundle links

steps.task: Implement per objective: Create repo-tracked architecture, registry, tool-contract, response-envelope, security-model, build-series, and decision docs for the multi-project read-only evidence facade. In-scope work: Author architecture docs under docs/03-reference/dcp/chatgpt-mcp-readonly/. Convert the GPT-5.5 architecture decisions into repo-tracked docs. Add TASK_ORCHESTRATOR_LOAD.md summarizing the TO load sequence. Add DECISIONS.md with explicit DCP decisions and rejected alternatives. Add task packet markdown files for TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0002 through TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0008. Update README.md and task-packets/INDEX.md if those files exist and pathing is confirmed.
requirements: Convert the GPT-5.5 architecture decisions into repo-tracked docs.
Add TASK_ORCHESTRATOR_LOAD.md summarizing the TO load sequence.
Add DECISIONS.md with explicit DCP decisions and rejected alternatives.
Add task packet markdown files for TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0002 through TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0008.
Update README.md and task-packets/INDEX.md if those files exist and pathing is confirmed.
validation: No files outside commit.allowlist are modified; change matches the stated scope.

steps.task: Run the packet validation commands and inspect the diff.
commands: rg -n "dopecon-bridge|search_all|project_id|readonly|read-only|registry|response envelope|Secure MCP Tunnel" docs/03-reference/dcp/chatgpt-mcp-readonly task-packets/dcp/chatgpt-mcp-readonly || true

steps.task: Produce the proof bundle under proof/TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0002/ (PROOF.json, COMMAND_LOG.md, AUDIT.md) and run the embedded audit.
requirements: PROOF.json with branch, head_sha, docs created, validation commands, exit codes.
AUDIT.md challenging authority labels, bridge denial, search_all denial, project registry assumptions, and scope boundaries.
validation: Proof bundle present with command outputs and exit codes.
Embedded audit verdict recorded (PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with non-blocking risks).
